tests.instruction: Natural, relaxed conversation. Sound human and engaged without overacting.
tests.text: Hey, thanks for joining us. I wanted to tell you about something we've been working on. It is simple, useful, and designed to make everyday communication feel a little more natural.

tests.instruction: Genuinely excited and energetic, but believable.
tests.text: We did it. After months of work, the doors finally open today, and I cannot wait for you to see what we built.

tests.instruction: Warm, reassuring and intimate without sounding artificial.
tests.text: Take a breath. You are exactly where you are supposed to be. There is no need to rush this moment.

tests.instruction: Confident, authoritative and clear. Avoid sounding aggressive.
tests.text: This is the most important decision your team will make this year. Choose the solution that gives your people room to do their best work.

tests.instruction: Expressive storytelling with natural pacing and meaningful pauses.
tests.text: The lights disappeared behind her as the train moved into the night. For the first time, she realized that there was no going back.

tests.instruction: Clear, natural English pronunciation. Preserve place names naturally.
tests.text: The South African team will meet in Johannesburg before travelling to Cape Town and Durban on Thursday.

tests.instruction: Natural narration. Maintain consistent character, pace and intelligibility across the full passage.
tests.text: Great products rarely begin with a perfect plan. They begin with a question, a problem worth solving, and someone willing to test an idea before it is ready. Over time, small decisions become a system. A useful system becomes a habit. And a habit, when shared by a team, can become a product that people trust. Svara Origins is being built around that principle: test the voices, measure what works, listen carefully, and keep improving the experience for the person who simply wants the right voice for the job.
